name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 21 - Am 113
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 21 a. Stresses that European regulatory inflation and the Green Deal are two serious threats to Union enterprises, blatantly contradicting the Union’s claim to support businesses; therefore calls for the suspension of the Green Deal and for regulatory deflation in the interest of enterprises;
